name: enterprise-playwright-framework
description: Enterprise-grade Playwright test automation framework with Page Object Model, Allure reporting, and traceability governance

scripts.report: allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
scripts.quality-gate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.prepare: node -e "try { const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('git rev-parse --git-dir', { stdio: 'ignore' }); if (require('fs').existsSync('.githooks')) { execSync('git config core.hooksPath .githooks', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } } catch {}"
